rae: MerchantLab signed LOI, legal wants perf numbers before final. They want a short POC: chat completions (1k context) + embedding pipeline. Can ops/eng propose a runbook and a quick price sketch for dedicated + burst?
matt: ok — clarifying questions: model variants? quantized only or FP16 too? target p95 latency and sustained qps?
rae: they want a realistic plan. target p95 <= 350ms for token streaming on the 13B quantized model, sustained 60 qps, 5-minute bursts to 300 qps. embeddings load: 1000 reqs/min, 512-d vectors.
jules: got it. plan idea: three phases — smoke, sustained ramp, and burst stress. we'll use synthetic prompts that mimic their avg token mix (prompt ~120 tokens, gen ~280 tokens). include KV cache warmup and a cold-start run.
matt: runbook sketch:
```
phase 1: smoke — 5m at 2 qps (validate routes)
phase 2: sustain — step ramp 0->60 qps over 10m, hold 30m, collect p50/p95/p99, token cost
phase 3: burst — 5x bursts: 5m at 300 qps with 2m cooldowns
metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, token/sec, GPU util, queuing reqs, error rate, tail latency by percentiles
```
jules: load generator: vegeta for HTTP streaming + a small headless client for SSE. example call: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream`
rae: can you also include a quick cost sketch for dedicated pool + burst? merchant lab asked for monthly committed + burst buffer pricing.
matt: rough math: dedicated pool to handle sustained 60 qps on 13B quantized -> ~2 x A100-equivalent GPUs (conservative) with autoscale margins => commit 2 units. burst cushion for 300 qps using burst capacity or pre-warmed nodes: 4 additional GPUs on-demand. approximate delta: committed monthly ~ $45k, burst buffer hourly burn when used ~ $120/hr per GPU * 4 -> $480/hr during bursts. I'll refine after actual CPU/GPU profiling.
sara: security check: MerchantLab requires CME/PII handling clause; they need KMS integration, customer-managed keys, and audit logs. confirm private networking (VPC peering) and TLS mutual auth for private deployment. SOC2 + penetration test report required before GA.
jules: for POC we can run in Dedicated preview with VPC peering and KMS. we'll capture audit logs and provide a scan artifact. need their legal contact to sign a Data Processing Addendum.
rae: henry (customer) is in thread — henry can you confirm their SSO/KMS contacts?
henry: confirming — security team wants HSM-backed keys and will share the questionnaire by EOD. also they want a short writeup on expected failure modes (queueing, backpressure) and our fallback (reduce model size, route to lower-fidelity variant).
matt: note on failure modes: main issues are cold-start latency, KV cache miss storms, and upstream network blips. mitigations: pre-warm nodes during ramp, prefix cache for common prompts, circuit-breaker with graceful degradation to 7B variant, and rate-limit/queue sizing. capture this in the runbook.
ops-bot: deploy-preview: dedicated/poc-cluster-merchantlab -> started at 2024-07-12T14:02:11Z :rocket:
rae: timeline — can we run smoke + sustain tomorrow? results and cost sketch in 48h?
jules: yes — schedule smoke tomorrow 09:30 PT. I'll own loadgen and result aggregation. matt will own infra sizing and cost calc. sara will validate KMS/VPC steps.
sara: quick note — we'll need a temporary KMS key in our account for the POC; long-term they need a customer-managed key in their cloud.
matt: for the results writeup I'll provide a short CSV with these columns: phase, qps, p50(ms), p95(ms), p99(ms), token/s, gpu_util(%), errors(%) and a short conclusions section.
rae: perfect. action items: jules — loadgen + payloads; matt — infra/cost numbers; sara — security checklist; henry — legal/security contacts + questionnaire. I'll consolidate and send to merchantlab. :thumbsup:
henry: sending contacts now, questionnaire will arrive in 2 hours. thanks everyone.
rae: thanks — keep thread updated. we'll attach the writeup to the CRM after run. :)
